name: equinox-workspace
description: Monorepo: the @jeprubio/playwright-a11y library and a sample app that uses it in its tests.

scripts.typecheck: npm run build:lib && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:lib && npm run test:lib && npm run test:sample
scripts.test:chromium: npm run build:lib && npm run test:chromium -w equinox-sample
scripts.test:ui: npm run build:lib && npm run test:ui -w equinox-sample
scripts.test:broken: npm run build:lib && npm run test:broken -w equinox-sample
scripts.focus-map: npm run build:lib && npm run focus-map -w equinox-sample
